verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents cron triggers: the Python SDK can "create and manage cron triggers that run workflows on a schedule," and there are dedicated Cron Runs and Scheduled Runs doc pages. The other parts of the story are unevidenced. Its concurrency strategies are general queue controls, not a documented cron overlap policy, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: cron-specific overlap policies, pause/resume of schedules, visibility into upcoming runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I schedule workflows on cron expressions with overlap policies, pause/resume, and visibility into upcoming runs
